change_control.review_note: Sweden ruleset verified against the current 2026 Embassy Working Holiday instructions and current visa application guidance.

summary_facts.label: Residence
summary_facts.value: Swedish citizen resident in Sweden at application

summary_facts.label: Participation
summary_facts.value: One Working Holiday visa, except tightly limited unused-visa reissue cases

summary_facts.label: Funds baseline
summary_facts.value: SEK 20,000 with return/onward ticket evidence; SEK 41,000 without

summary_facts.label: Application route
summary_facts.value: In person or registered mail to the Embassy of Japan in Sweden

eligibility_rules.label: Are you a Swedish citizen?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: This Working Holiday route is for Swedish citizens.

eligibility_rules.label: Are you resident in Sweden when applying?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Swedish Working Holiday applicants must be resident in Sweden when applying.

eligibility_rules.label: Your age at the time you expect to apply
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Swedish Working Holiday age range is 18–30 inclusive at application.

eligibility_rules.label: Is your primary purpose to holiday in Japan?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Applicants whose primary purpose is employment cannot use the Swedish Working Holiday route.

eligibility_rules.label: Will dependants without their own valid Japanese status accompany you?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: Dependants must independently hold a Working Holiday or other valid Japanese status.

eligibility_rules.label: Can you truthfully meet the good-health and medical-insurance requirements?
eligibility_rules.fail_message: The Swedish programme requires good health and adequate medical insurance.

funds_rule.input_label: Cleared funds shown in your Swedish bank statements (SEK)

jurisdiction.label: Embassy of Japan in Sweden — Stockholm
jurisdiction.description: Applicants must be in Sweden at application. Working Holiday documents may be submitted in person or by registered mail to the Embassy.
jurisdiction.ui_help: Swedish applicants must be resident/in Sweden at application and use the Embassy in Stockholm.

options.label: I am resident and currently in Sweden
options.mission_label: Embassy of Japan in Sweden — Stockholm
options.mission_detail: Submit the complete application in person or by registered mail. The Working Holiday page says to apply at least three weeks before anticipated departure.

options.label: I am not currently in Sweden
options.mission_label: Swedish application route may not apply
options.mission_detail: Current Embassy guidance says the applicant must be in Sweden at the time of application.
options.issue: The Swedish Working Holiday application requires the applicant to be in Sweden at the time of application.

document_checklist.title: Valid Swedish passport
document_checklist.description: Original Swedish passport with at least two blank visa pages.

document_checklist.title: Completed and hand-signed visa application form
document_checklist.description: Fill the current form digitally and sign it by hand.

document_checklist.title: Recent 35×45mm photograph
document_checklist.description: Provide a current photograph taken within the previous six months and meeting the Embassy specification.

document_checklist.title: Curriculum Vitae
document_checklist.description: Prepare Form 1 in Japanese or English.

document_checklist.title: Outline of intended stay and activities
document_checklist.description: Prepare Form 2 in Japanese or English.

document_checklist.title: A4 reason for applying
document_checklist.description: Prepare the typed Working Holiday motivation statement in Japanese or English.

document_checklist.title: Three months of bank statements
document_checklist.description: Show SEK 41,000 clear funds without return/onward ticket evidence, or SEK 20,000 plus the ticket/receipt.

document_checklist.title: National Health Insurance pledge or overseas travel insurance
document_checklist.description: Provide the permitted health-insurance pledge or original overseas travel insurance valid for the stay.

preparation_checklist.title: Apply at least three weeks before departure
preparation_checklist.description: The Working Holiday page says short-notice applications are not accepted.

preparation_checklist.title: Choose in-person or registered-mail submission
preparation_checklist.description: Follow the current Embassy mailing/personal-delivery instructions and account for passport handling time.

preparation_checklist.title: Match funds to ticket evidence
preparation_checklist.description: The current threshold is SEK 20,000 with return/onward evidence or SEK 41,000 without.

preparation_checklist.title: Run a final official-source check
preparation_checklist.description: Recheck the Embassy Working Holiday and visa application pages before sending or delivering the application.
